names.name: The Storm on the Sea of Galilee

summary: Dramatic seascape by Rembrandt of Jesus and his followers in a boat tossed by waves. It was his only seascape. It was one of thirteen works stolen from a Boston museum in 1990 and has not been seen in public since.
aliases: Storm on the Sea of Galilee

events.label: Stolen
events.note: Taken from the Isabella Stewart Gardner Museum in Boston. It has not been recovered.
